SELECT max(ORDER_ID) FROM STL_PAY_ORDERS
AND TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT max(TRADE_ID) FROM STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH
AND ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

SELECT DISTINCT case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SPO.MY_ACCT_NO else SPO.COUNTER_ACCT_NO end payAcctNo, case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SPO.COUNTER_ACCT_NO else SPO.MY_ACCT_NO end recAcctNo, case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SCI.ACCT_NAME else SCI1.ACCT_NAME end payAcctName, case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SCI1.ACCT_NAME else SCI.ACCT_NAME end recAcctName, SPO.PS, SPO.IS_NEED_SEND, SPO.PAY_TYPE, SPO.SETTLE_DATE, SPO.SETTLE_AMT, SPO.CCY, SPO.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, SPO.SETTLE_STATUS, SPO.PURPOSE, SDTM.TRADE_ID, SPO.ORDER_ID, SPO.REMARK -- SPO.TRU_SEQNO truSeqno FROM STL_DVP_ORDERS SPO INNER JOIN STL_DVP_TRADE_MATCH SDTM ON SPO.ORDER_ID = SDTM.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO SCI ON SPO.MY_ACCT_NO = SCI.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO SCI1 ON SPO.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = SCI1.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON SPO.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE SDTM.TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}

with V_MaxDealDate as (select max(t.dealdate) maxdealdate from interf_ods_account_cash t where t.account=#{account} and t.netno=#{netno} and t.ccy=#{ccy}) select t1.reprinamt from V_MaxDealDate v1 left join interf_ods_account_cash t1 on v1.maxdealdate=t1.dealdate and t1.account=#{account} and t1.netno=#{netno} and t1.ccy=#{ccy}
